description: This file defines the AzureGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface. It provides functionality to initialize and retrieve a list of gateway URIs for Azure-based Orleans silos, including configuration options and management of silo instances.

classes.name: AzureGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to manage and provide gateway endpoints for Azure-based Orleans silos.

methods.name: AzureGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with necessary dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the silo instance manager.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns a list of gateway URIs, representing available gateway endpoints.
